scope.current_boundary: Teach amount of substance as an SI base quantity with the base unit mol, the mole, the Avogadro constant N_A, elementary entities, molar mass, and calculating particle count from mass and moles. Do not pre-teach the ideal gas equation pV = nRT, thermodynamic temperature, or kinetic theory.

immediate_previous.boundary: No previous lesson in Topic 15; this is the opening lesson of Topic 15 (Ideal gases).

immediate_next.boundary: Ideal gas definition, equation of state pV = nRT and pV = NkT, thermodynamic temperature.
must_not_preteach: ideal gas definition pV proportional to T
equation of state pV = nRT and pV = NkT
thermodynamic temperature scale and absolute zero
